duration.text: The Linguistics and Applied Linguistics at Dalian University of Foreign Languages is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3333 USD/per year ￥ 24000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 7 or above 6.Letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens less than 40 2.Be in good health condition 3.HSK level 7 or above 4.Must possess an undergraduate diploma and transcript from accredited universities 5.After passing Graduate Entrance Exams and fulfilling the graduate student requirements, students can study the courses for graduate students.
